extensionName.description: Name shown in the Firefox add-ons list and toolbar.

extensionDescription.message: Reviews a prepared answer and places it in the focused Hawkes answer field only when you ask. It never submits, checks, or navigates.

popupInsertButton.description: Label of the button that performs the insertion.

popupOptionsLink.description: Link from the popup to the add-on preferences page.

popupSafetyNote.message: Ethnos runs locally and never submits, checks, or navigates. You review every answer before it is inserted. Closing this panel does not stop a solve.
popupSafetyNote.description: Standing scope note shown at the bottom of the popup.

statusChecking.description: Shown while the popup inspects the page.

statusReady.message: Answer field found. Solve when you are ready.

statusInserting.description: Shown while an insertion is in flight.

statusInserted.message: Inserted. Submit it, then reopen for the next question.

errorNoTab.message: No active Firefox tab was found.
errorNoTab.description: Error when the active tab cannot be resolved.

errorWrongSite.message: Open this panel from a Hawkes lesson tab at learn.hawkeslearning.com.
errorWrongSite.description: Error when the active tab is not the approved host.

errorNoBridge.message: The Hawkes page could not be inspected. Reload the lesson and try again.
errorNoBridge.description: Error when the content script cannot be injected or reached.

errorNoFocusedField.message: Close this panel, click the empty Hawkes answer box, then open it again.
errorNoFocusedField.description: Error when no editable answer field holds focus.

errorFieldNotEditable.message: The focused field is read-only, so nothing was inserted.
errorFieldNotEditable.description: Error when the focused field is disabled or read-only.

errorUnsupportedField.message: The focused element is not a supported answer field.
errorUnsupportedField.description: Error when the focused element cannot accept text.

errorInsertRejected.message: The Hawkes editor rejected the insertion. Nothing was changed.
errorInsertRejected.description: Error when the page cancels or refuses the input.

errorAnswerInvalid.message: The saved answer is not a supported plain-text answer. Fix it in Settings.
errorAnswerInvalid.description: Error when the stored answer fails validation.

optionsScopeHeading.description: Heading of the standing scope list.

optionsScopeSite.message: Acts only on https://learn.hawkeslearning.com, and only after you click the toolbar button.
optionsScopeSite.description: Scope bullet about the site allowlist.

optionsScopeGesture.message: Inserts text only into the field you focused, and only after a second click.
optionsScopeGesture.description: Scope bullet about the required user gesture.

optionsScopeNoSubmit.message: Never submits, checks, navigates, or selects a different question.
optionsScopeNoSubmit.description: Scope bullet about submission being out of scope.

optionsScopeNoNetwork.message: Makes no network requests and stores nothing except the answer above.

errorFrameUnreachable.message: The answer field is inside a frame this add-on is not allowed to reach. Click the answer box itself, then reopen this panel.
errorFrameUnreachable.description: Error when the focused field sits in a frame activeTab does not cover.

errorAnswerChanged.message: The saved answer changed while this panel was open, so nothing was inserted. Reopen the panel to review it.
errorAnswerChanged.description: Error when the inserted value no longer matches the reviewed one.

errorFrameUnreachableAt.message: The answer field is inside $ORIGIN$, which this add-on has no permission to reach. Grant that one host in Firefox's add-on settings, or click the answer box directly and reopen this panel.
errorFrameUnreachableAt.description: Error when the focused field is in a named cross-origin frame.

errorFrameAmbiguous.message: More than one frame reports a focused answer field, so nothing was inserted. Click the box you mean and reopen this panel.
errorFrameAmbiguous.description: Error when several frames claim the caret and the target is ambiguous.

popupSolveButton.description: Button that captures the question and asks Ethnos to solve it.

popupProblemHeading.description: Heading above the transcription Ethnos read back.

statusSolved.message: Ready. Check it against the screen, then press Insert.
statusSolved.description: Shown when an answer is ready and insertable.

errorEthnosUnreachable.message: Ethnos is not reachable. Run deploy/firefox/install_native_host.py --write, then restart Firefox.
errorEthnosUnreachable.description: Error when the native host is missing or refused.

errorEthnosTimeout.message: Ethnos did not answer in time. It may still be loading a model; try again.
errorEthnosTimeout.description: Error when the host exceeds the request timeout.

errorEthnosVersion.message: Ethnos replied with a protocol this add-on does not speak. Update both sides.
errorEthnosVersion.description: Error on a protocol version mismatch.

errorNoCapture.message: The question could not be captured from this tab.

errorQuestionRegion.message: The question region could not be isolated safely, so no screenshot was sent. For an unusual layout, you can explicitly turn off question-region limiting in Settings and retry.
errorQuestionRegion.description: Privacy error when a screenshot cannot be cropped without including unrelated page content.

errorSolveRefused.message: Ethnos would not answer this question. The reason is shown below.
errorSolveRefused.description: Error when the host returns a non-ready status.

errorTranscriptionDisputed.message: Ethnos's two readers disagreed about the question, so nothing may be inserted. Read the notes below.
errorTranscriptionDisputed.description: Error when image transcription was not independently confirmed.

errorAnswerNeedsTemplate.message: Needs a keypad template ($STRUCTURE$), which cannot be typed. The answer is above — build it with the keypad.
errorAnswerNeedsTemplate.description: Shown when the answer requires structure the add-on cannot build.

errorAnswerRejected.message: This question's answer box does not accept: $CHARS$. Nothing was inserted.
errorAnswerRejected.description: Shown when the editor's own character set rejects the answer.

errorEditorUnknown.message: The answer editor could not be read, so nothing was inserted. Click the answer box and reopen this panel.
errorEditorUnknown.description: Shown when the editor model could not be inspected.

errorAnswerNeedsAbsoluteValue.message: This answer needs absolute-value bars, but this question does not offer that keypad template. The answer is shown above; enter it manually only if Hawkes permits it.
errorAnswerNeedsAbsoluteValue.description: Shown when an answer needs absolute value but the question does not publish that editor template.

errorQuestionChanged.message: The question changed, so that answer was not inserted. Solving the question now on screen.
errorQuestionChanged.description: Shown when the question on screen no longer matches the one the answer was solved for.

errorQuestionUnverified.message: The current question could not be verified, so nothing was inserted. Solve it again when the question is readable.
errorQuestionUnverified.description: Shown when the final question identity cannot be read before insertion.

commandOpenPanel.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut that opens the popup.

popupCancelButton.description: Button that abandons an in-progress solve.

popupDetailToggle.description: Toggle revealing the technical detail line.

popupSourceBadge.description: Badge naming which stage produced the answer.

statusElapsed.description: Elapsed seconds appended while a solve runs.

errorEditorDialogOpen.message: Hawkes has a message box open, which blocks the answer field. Close it, then try again.
errorEditorDialogOpen.description: Error when a Hawkes modal is holding focus.

errorTabAccessLost.message: Hawkes access is not granted. Grant access to use the sidebar across navigation.
errorTabAccessLost.description: Error when neither the site permission nor a current activeTab grant is available.

errorOperationTimeout.message: The page did not respond. Reload the lesson and try again.
errorOperationTimeout.description: Error when a page operation exceeds its deadline.

errorOptionAnswer.message: Answered by choosing an option. The answer is above — select it yourself; Ethnos does not click choices.
errorOptionAnswer.description: Shown when the focused control is a radio option rather than a field.

stageReading.description: Progress stage: first transcription of the image.

statusWillBuild.message: Ready. Check it against the screen, then press Insert — it builds this with the keypad for you.
statusWillBuild.description: Shown when the answer will be assembled from templates rather than typed.

errorTemplateRefused.message: This question does not offer the $STRUCTURE$ template, so the answer cannot be entered here. Check the problem above.
errorTemplateRefused.description: Shown when the answer needs a template the question disallows.

popupResetButton.description: Button that clears the panel and re-checks the current question.

optionsAutoSolveLabel.message: Start solving as soon as the panel finds the answer field

optionsAutoSolveHelp.message: Saves a click per question. Turn it off to press Solve yourself.
optionsAutoSolveHelp.description: Help text for the automatic-solve preference.

popupCloseTitle.description: Tooltip for the panel's close button.

popupRetryButton.description: Label on the primary button after a failure.

popupGrantAccessButton.description: Button that requests access to the single Hawkes Learning host after Firefox withholds it.

popupCopyTitle.description: Tooltip on the button that copies the answer text.

popupCopied.description: Confirmation shown after copying to the clipboard.

popupCopyFailed.message: Firefox would not let the panel use the clipboard.
popupCopyFailed.description: Shown when a clipboard write is refused.

popupHintSolve.description: Footer hint naming what the Enter key does.

popupHintCancel.description: Footer hint while a solve is running.

popupHintInsert.description: Footer hint once an answer can be inserted.

panelFault.message: The panel hit an internal error, so what is shown may be out of date. The solve itself is unaffected and is still running in the background.
panelFault.description: Banner shown when the panel's own code throws.

panelFaultCopy.description: Button that copies the diagnostic log after a panel fault.

panelFaultReload.description: Button that reloads the panel document after a fault.

optionsCropLabel.message: Limit screenshots to the question region

optionsCropHelp.message: Recommended. If the region cannot be isolated safely, nothing is sent. Turn this off only for an unusual question layout.
optionsCropHelp.description: Help text for the screenshot-cropping preference.

optionsTimeoutLabel.message: Give up on a solve after
optionsTimeoutLabel.description: Label for the solve timeout preference.

optionsTimeoutUnit.description: Unit beside the solve timeout field.

optionsTimeoutHelp.message: A larger vision model on a slower machine needs longer. 30 to 900.
optionsTimeoutHelp.description: Help text for the solve timeout preference.

optionsWidthLabel.description: Label for the panel width preference.

optionsWidthValue.description: Current panel width beside its slider.

optionsWidthHelp.message: Firefox sizes a popup to its content, so this is the whole of the control there is over it. Wider makes long problem text easier to check.
optionsWidthHelp.description: Help text for the panel width preference.

optionsProblemOpenLabel.description: Label for the preference that unfolds the recognized problem.

optionsProblemOpenHelp.message: Checking the transcription is the point of showing it; expanding it by default costs a little panel height.
optionsProblemOpenHelp.description: Help text for the recognized-problem preference.

optionsShortcutLabel.description: Label for the toolbar-button keyboard shortcut.

optionsShortcutSave.description: Button that applies a new keyboard shortcut.

optionsShortcutReset.description: Button that restores the default keyboard shortcut.

optionsShortcutApplied.description: Confirmation after changing the keyboard shortcut.

optionsShortcutInvalid.message: Firefox would not accept that combination. Try one with Alt, Ctrl or Command.
optionsShortcutInvalid.description: Shown when Firefox rejects a keyboard shortcut.

optionsConnectionHeading.description: Heading for the native-host connection check.

optionsConnectionHelp.message: Asks the local host to identify itself. It loads no model, so this answers at once — before a solve spends a minute finding out.
optionsConnectionHelp.description: Help text for the connection check.

optionsConnectionTest.description: Button that checks the native host is reachable.

optionsConnectionChecking.description: Shown while the connection check is running.

optionsConnectionOk.description: Shown when the native host replies.

optionsLogLevelLabel.description: Label for the log level preference.

optionsLogLevelHelp.message: Kept on this machine, capped at 200 entries, and cleared with the button below. Answers, recognized problems and screenshots are never recorded — only their shapes.
optionsLogLevelHelp.description: Help text for the log level preference.

optionsDiagnosticsRefresh.description: Button that re-reads the diagnostic log.

optionsDiagnosticsCopy.description: Button that copies the diagnostic log.

optionsDiagnosticsClear.description: Button that erases the diagnostic log.

optionsDiagnosticsCleared.description: Confirmation after erasing the diagnostic log.

optionsDiagnosticsEmpty.description: Shown when the diagnostic log is empty.

optionsDiagnosticsCount.description: Summary line beneath the diagnostic log.

optionsCopyFailed.message: Firefox would not let the page use the clipboard.
optionsCopyFailed.description: Shown when a clipboard write is refused on the settings page.

optionsResetDone.message: Every preference is back to its default.

optionsSaveFailed.message: That preference could not be saved.
optionsSaveFailed.description: Shown when writing a preference to storage fails.

commandOpenSidebar.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut that opens the sidebar.

popupSidebarHint.message: Open in the sidebar so it stays put while solving.
popupSidebarHint.description: Offered in the popup, which closes whenever focus moves.
